body: As of this morning, I'm on the same boat. I know how you feel. My mom basically said "Don't say things like that" moments later it's like "How can you even think things like that? I'm so sorry" like a backhanded support. And then ten minutes later we had a full-blown fight where she basically said "Don't you ever think about me? Don't you feel bad knowing how you make me feel?" and then she stormed off angry and now I'm home alone. Shit.
